skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the fundamental concepts, theories, and philosophies of managing organizational functions.
Demonstrate the ability to collect information, analyze, and make decisions to solve problems related to managing organizational functions.
Practice soft skills such as teamwork, communication, negotiation, planning, and organization.
Present and defend personal viewpoints based on an objective and systematic approach.
Understand social context, management environment, professional ethics, and social responsibility.
Understand the role and position of marketing management in an organization.
Understand the role and position of financial management in an organization.
Understand the role and position of human resource management in an organization.
Understand the role and position of production management in an organization.
Understand the role and position of research and development management in an organization.
Understand the role and position of quality management in an organization.
